Schedule 3.12 states the Company "intends to deliver the Renewal Notice prior to Closing," ... If the Renewal Notice was not delivered by August 16, 2026, the Distribution Agreement **expires by its own terms on November 14, 2026**—sixteen days before the Target Closing Date of November 30, 2026. ... The representation in MIPA § 3.12(c) that the Distribution Agreement "remains in effect through November 2029" would be false.
